title: CVE-2026-133968 added to CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
summary_en: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.
lines: Project MONAI MONAI Label: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability

Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.
